title: Desert Bubble Dream
description: A large red mouse in a purple robe stands on a sand dune and blows bubbles from a small wand held in its hand. Above float many iridescent bubbles containing tiny desert scenes with cacti, smaller mice, and robed figures while a glowing red eye watches from the sky over a colorful geometric dome that leaks liquid onto the sand.
prompt: A large red mouse wearing a purple robe stands on a sand dune blowing bubbles from a wand held in its hand. Many floating iridescent bubbles contain tiny desert scenes with cacti small mice and robed figures. A glowing red eye sits in a red circle in the sky above. In the foreground a colorful geometric dome leaks liquid onto the sand creating a glowing puddle. Stars and constellations fill the night sky.
